mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYROLLS ( staff_id, staff_name, salary_period, position_id, position_name, base_salary, working_days, total_bonus, total_deduction, final_salary, status ) VALUES ( #{staffId}, #{staffName}, #{salaryPeriod}, #{positionId}, #{positionName}, #{baseSalary}, #{workingDays}, #{totalBonus}, #{totalDeduction}, #{finalSalary}, 'PENDING' ) ON CONFLICT (staff_id, salary_period) DO UPDATE SET position_id = EXCLUDED.position_id, position_name = EXCLUDED.position_name, base_salary = EXCLUDED.base_salary, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYROLLS SET total_bonus = #{totalBonus}, total_deduction = #{totalDeduction}, final_salary = #{finalSalary}, status = #{status}, note = #{note}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, approved_name = #{approvedName}, approved_at = now(), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE PAYROLLS SET status = 'PAID', paid_at = now(), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAYROLLS WHERE staff_id = #{staffId}

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY staff_id) as stt, staff_id, staff_name, base_salary, total_bonus, total_deduction, final_salary FROM PAYROLLS
AND salary_period LIKE CONCAT(#{period}, '-%')
AND salary_period = #{period}
AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'PAID')

SELECT NULL as stt, NULL as staff_id, 'TỔNG CỘNG' as staff_name, SUM(base_salary) as base_salary, SUM(total_bonus) as total_bonus, SUM(total_deduction) as total_deduction, SUM(final_salary) as final_salary FROM PAYROLLS
AND salary_period LIKE CONCAT(#{period}, '-%')
AND salary_period = #{period}
AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'PAID')
